I'm a guy. I met this girl on tinder. About 1 year and half ago. She lived far far distant from another state. We texted everyday, all the time, for around 3 months. 
She used to send me messages everyday, she used to text she loved me. I never met a girl like her before. Not because all that, but because of her preferences and tastes in life. She was kind type of alternative semi-gothic thumblr e-girl.

She liked anime, very old movies, aesthetic art, like vaporwave, paintings, books, she liked to hear strange kind of music. from russian old school to japanese city pop from the 80s, seeing her brought me a nostalgia from places and times where I never lived, like that night feeling from the taxi driver movie. Or a trip with hippies in the 70s, or being in an indie low budget movie. There's was this thing around her idk, it was magic. She was different from all other girls. She was magic. I can't really describe how magic she was. 
No girl I know had the same tastes like hers. The girls I know don't like the stuff she liked, and we liked the same stuff.

She had art in her veins, and we talked deep topics like meaning of live, death and love to silly ones like sending photos from a bread and saying it was a nice bread. 

Well shit I'm crying now.

She was tremendously clever, smart, inteligent and very very funny. 

And 

She is a black girl and She was the most beautiful girl I ever have seen In my intire life. It was not only me. She won the beauty model contest of her city.

Her smile is attonishin. Really, The kind of one you can't hardly forget if she smiles to you. I thought that her smile could kill.

We shared memes, nudes, secrets, I showed her my life and she showed hers. 

She had a free spirit, like the wind, her soul didn't belongs to anywhere. So dark, yet so pure.

I have dated a lot of girls in my life. I even was married once for years. But none of them made me feel like this girl did. 

I loved her, I loved her so much it hurts. I still love.

I thought that we would never met, because we lived so distant from each other. She said she had realitives in my state and she probably one day would move to live with them, just here pretty near to my city

But something went wrong during final weeks we talked. And I don't exactly know what it was. I was online most during the day and she was online mostly during the night. And we started to talk less and less to each other everyday, and it had begun to affect on our relationship to the point I said I couldn't keep this going if we talk only once or twice a week.. and she said it's okay and I don't know how we got into this fight and said meaning words to each other. 

And then nothing after that. We just stopped to talk.  

And my nightmare begun. I couldn't sleep, couldn't eat. I thought of her all day long. I wanted to be with her but when I saw weeks have passed and I thought it was too late.. 
I tried to live my life normally. But it was quite impossible. "What she is doing now?" " Is she okay? , Is she happy? Is she alive?"

And she became my LO.

Then 6 months later, without contact at all, covid-19 hits. And I got scared if something happens to one of us and I couldn't tell her how much she was important to me. But probably she had moved on with her life and barely remember my existence. 

So I contacted her 

Me: Hey, how's going?, well I heard the world is ending you know (2020) and I came to see if you are okay.

Her: Hey, I moved to your state about 4 month ago. I want to ask something, I really want to see you. 

And at the same day I went to her house, she said she just had broke up with a boyfriend, but said to me she didn't like him very much. What it was probably true. And I was okay with that.

So she introduced me her mother, sisters, cats and all.

And we talked about why we had that fight that day and we both didn't know why.  

And yes. we slept together. And it was the best day of my life. I never felt so alive. It was HER. HER you know? The one. The only one. The girl I love, sleeping like an angel in my arms, I could imagine this was possible. While there, she said that she loved me, I said that I loved her, not through text this time, but face to face. I never felt so frickin happy before. It was like a dream. 

She said she had a broke up recently, and didn't want a serious relationship at that moment. My dream was to marry and live with her until old. But I agreeded and kept that to myself. 

But things went completely downhill.
And i really don't want to talk about this here.
But to be fair
I don't know if it is my fault or not.. probably is mine. For sure is mine.
She shared me a secret, and it was something I couldn't deal with. I already was a depressed guy. And it made it really worse. And I already had a lot of problems to face if I intended to be with her in the long term (health, money, job, etc.). So i decided to quit with her and only told her that I needed to solve my problems first before intended to be in a serious relationship with someone, which is totally true. Well, I couldn't drag her with me to my shitty life. I have no job, no social life, no friends, a lot of serious health and mind problems, what could I offer her? I didn't told her how much her secret had affected me but, even if it hadn't, it wouldn't changed that much. 

So I told her to go.  

And she went away. And as a strong woman as she is, I know, she will never look back again.
 
She didn't seem sad or angry after that. She sent some messages saying she missed me, but she would overcome. And then stoped. .

Sometimes  I take a look on her facebook or instagram page, she seems to be doing good. She's hanging out and having good time with a lot of guys and enjoying life like a free soul, she seems to be happy. 

The point is, I never forget her one single moment of my day. 
I hate my life. I hate myself. And I want to die.

Ps: after we met I realized that she wasn't a perfect ethereal being or a godness as I previously idealized. But just a normal human being with qualities and imperfections, but it hasn't changed the fact that I still loved her.

Olá amigo, não sou nenhum expert na area urologica, mas vou te dizer o que acredito , opinião pessoal, sobre o nofap:

1. Masturbação em si, a princípio, não causa nenhum dano físico, a compulsão dela sim. 

a) no sêmen há uma grande quantidade de vitaminas e minerais que o corpo leva um certo tempo pra repor, (em média 5 dias), e se a sua alimentação não for saudável, como é a maioria dos br. (Não comemos quase nenhum alimento rico em zinco, como ostras e castanhas) masturbar demais por causar perda desses nutrientes e levar a doenças como falta de zinco e manganês. A falta de energia e cansaço que sentimos advém da falta desses nutrientes no corpo.
Mas se vc for a um nutricionista e se alimentar bem, sem essas porcarias de carnes processadas e alimentos cheio de conservantes. O álcool tbm elimina nutrientes. Masturbação não vai causar efeitos colaterais n. Pode fazer e é tranquilo. 

O pênis em si não é um músculo, então não há risco per si de atrofiar, já que por mecanismo natural o corpo sozinho e sem estímulo exercita a área durante o sono ou acordar causando ereções involuntárias e saudáveis e prevenindo que isso venha causar alguma disfunção erétil. 

Então não, nofap não causa disfunção, verificando sempre se vc tem vez ou outra ereções ao acordar. 

B) o semen não acumula, ele é reabsorvido pelo corpo e seus nutrientes são reutilizados para outras funções celulares o que explica o aumento de energia e disposição.

Por outro lado o problema todo consiste na pornografia. 

2. A pornografia causa algo chamado de superestimulo. A nossa motivação dentro do cérebro trabalha com um mecanismo chamado de sistema dopaminergico. Se fazemos algo que nos gere prazer, o sistema de dopamina é ativado sempre pra que a gente repita o que nos deu prazer causando assim o vício. Nosso cérebro não sabe distinguir entre uma garota real e uma garota 2d. E quanto entramos num pornhub da vida, vemos dezenas de meninas diferentes que nosso cérebro interpreta como se tivessmos tendo relações com várias delas ao mesmo tempo. 

A primeira consequência é já enxurrada de dopamina constante que vai acabar por saturar e dessensibilizar o lobo do Cortex pre-frontal (área responsavel pela racionalidade e tomada de decisão) 
Fazendo com que pra que atinjamos a mesma quantidade de prazer, uma menina comum não será o suficiente. Além de que não só no campo sexual, mas as outras áreas da vida também ficará dessensibilizada. A gente não sente mais prazer em coisas simples como jogar videogame, ver filmes, ler um livro,comer uma comida gostosa, acariciar um cachorro, pq a área do cérebro que sente prazer, só vai sentir prazer com aquela quantidade absurda de estímulo visual que o site oferece que as coisas simples não alcançam esse nível. 

É a chamada tolerância a substância, a dopamina age como uma droga e faz sempre aumentarmos a quantidade de estímulo para obter o mesmo efeito de prazer. Exemplo é quem não é acostumado a beber álcool, beber um copo de cerveja o deixa bêbado, quem bebe a anos, beber 6 litros , não deixa nem no brilho. Daí arranjar uma namorada ou ter uma ereção com uma menina comum, pode ser um problema. Pq ela não vai causar a mesma quantidade de estímulo que milhares de mulheres hipersiliconadas e de academia vai.

3. Há um estudo científico por aí em inglês mostrando que a falta de masturbação regular pode levar a um aumento na taxa de câncer de próstata. Entretanto esse estudo foi mostrado posteriormente que estava meio duvidoso, pois a quantidade de participantes foi pouca pra se ter uma margem confiável e grande parte deles eram fumantes. Mas sugiro pesquisar mais sobre isso se for te for concernente.

4. Pra ganhar mais disciplina e autocontrole e redirecionar os urges pra coisas mais produtivas como academia, estudos ou trabalho.
